name: San Giovanni Teatino (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of San Giovanni Teatino (a cross and the letters F and B on black) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of San Giovanni Teatino, a comune in Abruzzo; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: San Giovanni Teatino arms — cross and the letters F and B on black, crowned, within branches
